chapters.title: Chapter 694 A genius in gambling on stones?
paragraphs: After cutting two pieces of jadeite in a row, Zhao An didn't care and simply threw them away. Some large pieces remained uncut, theoretically suggesting they might be jadeite.

These stones would be taken back for selection and then sold. The prices were naturally very low, ranging from tens to hundreds of yuan. This was also a way for tourists to try their hand at jadeite. It offered a small profit margin, quick turnover, and also allowed them to clear out the rough jadeite—a win-win situation.
When the fifth piece of jadeite showed a hint of translucent green, an expert exclaimed, "Imperial Green!"

Jadeite is categorized into many different grades: old pit glass, water, ice, ice-glutinous, glutinous, and other lesser-quality varieties. From imperial green, bright green, apple green, to red, yellow, and purple, there's every kind.

And now, the water-imperial green appeared. This small piece, the size of a thumbnail, fetched millions. A larger piece, with an average of one centimeter, would fetch millions more. The price is incalculable.

These high-end jade markets are all aimed at the wealthy. Price isn't the issue; quality is key. Sales volume isn't the issue; authenticity is key. The high-end jade market is generally in short supply. The quality of the jade determines the lower limit of the jewelry, while a good craftsman determines the upper limit.

"Young Master An, this is a good sign! This is a top-notch water-grade imperial green. How about letting my people polish it? I guarantee you'll get a satisfactory price." Qian Zilai's eyes lit up slightly, clearly moved. This was just too damn lucky.
You know, the price of high-end jade has always been surprisingly high because the raw material is so expensive and scarce. The finest quality is almost impossible to find.
Zhao An took another cut. The smooth, deep green was both captivating and profound, captivating.
Just looking at those two smears of green, one could almost feel the money rushing towards them. Even as a work of art, this kind of thing would be incredibly useful.
Priceless! Almost everyone was moved, their breathing quickening. Who could remain calm in the face of jadeite worth tens of millions? Perhaps even more than that, perhaps even hundreds of millions.

Seeing Zhao An take another cut, not only did the jadeite's price not drop, but it actually revealed another hint of green, Qian Zilai's eyelids twitched wildly. Was this genius? He was a genius at gambling, so what else could possibly stump him?
In fact, this wasn't Zhao An's genius. With his clairvoyance, he smoked a cigarette and feigned a casualness as he made a few cuts. This was outrageous and made him look completely amateurish.
It was precisely this amateurishness that made people think he was lucky, having easily snagged such exquisite jadeite!
Watching the people around him breathing increasingly rapidly, they all left to find some rough material to satisfy their cravings.
Seeing others making money, it was inevitable that he'd want to get in on the action. It was a bit itchy, and a bit hard to control.
Zhao An set his tools aside. "Let's go! I'll leave these things to you. Work hard. Remember to pay me in full, and contact my secretary for the rest."

"Okay, Young Master An, don't worry. I'll take care of everything for you," Qian Zilai said with a slight servility. After all, he was a well-known member of the Qian family, the younger brother of the Qian family head. But when it came to Zhao An, he still had to bow down. Who could resist money?
Zhao An didn't care about money, but Qian Zilai didn't dare to do anything. He took what he paid. This kind of profit-making partnership was a good start, and they could continue to work together.

How many people wanted to work with Zhao An but couldn't find a way? This guy was a freak who made money without going public, completely controlling the company. Even a very profitable company like Haotuan Waimai was directly nationalized, sold to the government. He was like a high-level agent, and he wouldn't be president for two years, at most.

This was a stepping stone. Obviously, such an action would result in significant losses, but the gains from giving up those profits could yield significant resources. As long as he didn't act recklessly, virtually no one could touch him.
This was the headache for the four major families. Other companies could resort to underhanded tactics, but Zhao An's company had no choice. This was a death order; there was no way around it.

The gains from giving up profits were exchanged for long-term peace. What was wrong with that? Zhao An, lacking connections, used this tactic, then switched the tables, forcing other rivals to compete with him, unable to resort to underhanded tactics.

Even with the transport fleet issue, the most he would have to do was pay some money and replace the fleet. There would be some impact, but it wouldn't be that severe, and it wasn't his fault, so he couldn't be wrongly accused. That was the core point.
At this moment, a staff member approached and whispered something to Qian Haoming.

Qian Haoming's eyes lit up, and he leaned close to Zhao An's ear and whispered, "Young Master An, Miss Lin, the person in charge here, wants to meet with us. What do you think? Miss Lin is from the Lin family and has always been in charge of the business here."

The Lin family, one of the four great families, had also appeared! Zhao An had never been able to reach them before, but now that their status and power had reached a certain level, it seemed natural that people would pay attention to them.

"Okay, it wouldn't hurt to go and take a look." Zhao An didn't mind. The more he saw, the broader his horizons. Although he had risen rapidly, his foundation was still a bit weak. Compared to those large families, there was still a huge gap in foundation. Therefore, cooperation would naturally be the best. Of course, if the other party wanted to step on his heels, he wouldn't mind breaking their legs!
Fang Shuiling arrived at the private room on the second floor and sat down. "Brother, what brings you here?"

"I'm here to take care of some business. Haha, don't go too wild. Huang Meng's face isn't looking too good. It's better to play around a bit while we're working together." Fang Shunli, clearly aware of his sister's behavior, didn't prohibit her, merely admonishing her to tone it down.

"Haha, he's got several mistresses, and they've even had children. Did I ever tell him anything?" Fang Shuiling's tone was filled with disdain. Playing around is one thing, but having a child? What's the big deal?
Besides, while Huang Meng was capable, he wasn't the heir, so Fang Shuiling had little respect for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 695 Lin family, Lin Yuanyuan
paragraphs: "Haha, just for fun, don't take it seriously." Fang Shunli chuckled, as if his brother-in-law's affair with a mistress and the subsequent child-bearing was perfectly normal.

It was indeed normal, very normal. Rich people behaved this way. Who knew if the next generation would be a brilliant talent? These matings were recorded. If there was a promising talent, they would be recruited into the family. If there wasn't anything exceptional, they would be left to fend for themselves.

Almost every family did this, and the Bai family was no exception; otherwise, Zhao An wouldn't have been recruited. This was essentially adultery in name only, permitted. This kind of adultery involved outsiders, not family members.
Even if he had sex with someone else's wife, it still needed to be recorded; at least it would be checked during family marriages.
It might seem that the lifestyle of a large family was a bit chaotic, but that was the reality. You'd just get used to it.

"He does his thing, I do mine, it's that simple." Fang Shuiling wasn't just a pretty face; she was also in charge of the hotel business. It was just that the hotel's business had always been like this: neither high nor low, just barely scraping by. "We've been cooperating lately, so just keep a low profile." Fang Shunli, sipping his red wine, frowned as he saw a staff member invite Zhao An to leave. This rival was going to be tough to deal with.

As for cooperation? It wasn't that Fang Shunli hadn't considered it, but his family disagreed, so he had no choice but to comply. Besides, the Fang and Huang families were joining forces, so they didn't need to look at the opinions of a commoner.
"Got it." Fang Shuiling glanced at Zhao An below, unintentionally noticing that his penis had bulged, looking rather impressive.

"If you have time, you can get in touch with that Zhao An and test his waters. Confrontation and cooperation are two different things, and getting to know him better would be a good thing." Fang Shunli's words were rather euphemistic, but in reality, he was asking his sister to seduce Zhao An. Even if such a clever man got pregnant, it would be very beneficial.
When the child was born, it would take the surname Fang, so there would be no loss either way.

As for being taken advantage of? How could having a child be considered taking advantage of someone for free? Instead, they'd gained a child with a potentially high IQ—no matter how you slice it, it was a win-win.

Fang Shuiling felt a flicker of displeasure. These words treated her like a mere socialite. She was, in reality, still a virgin, merely feigning promiscuity. She truly wanted to emulate Qian Yuling, the epitome of a strong woman in the upper echelons of society.
"You want me to seduce him, huh?" Fang Shuiling's voice was a bit cold, her expression impassive.

"Not really. Just testing the waters. That kind of person is hard to seduce, and our Fang family doesn't need such tactics." Fang Shunli's words were high-sounding, but everyone knew exactly what he was thinking.
Zhao An followed the service staff to the third floor, where the office was located. Here, they could even see guards armed with real guns.

"The security guards here are all from a security company, the Lin family's own, and they use real guns," Qian Haoming explained quietly, never missing an opportunity to show off. "Well, that's more reasonable. Otherwise, there are billions of raw materials here. Wouldn't it be a shame if they were robbed?" Zhao An's expression was calm, almost unsurprising.

The group continued forward and soon arrived at the office at the end. The waiter knocked on the door, then opened it after receiving a reply, and made an inviting gesture to Zhao An and the others, "Gentlemen, please come in."

The office was decorated simply and elegantly, without any extraneous bookshelves or decorations. There was just a sofa and an exquisite tea table. A transparent glass pot filled with boiling water and a teapot with tea leaves already in it—a Southern Gongfu tea style. While it was essentially a self-poured tea brewing process, it wasn't anything fancy, but they had invested heavily in the materials, which gave it a more elegant look.

A woman with short hair stepped out from the desk in eight-centimeter black round-toed heels. She had a pretty face and walked with a steady gait. Long experience in the workplace has honed her calm demeanor. Though not a stunning beauty, her charismatic demeanor is still unforgettable.

"Mr. Zhao, Mr. Qian, hello. I'm Lin Yuanyuan, the manager here. Nice to meet you, Mr. Zhao. Mr. Qian and I are acquaintances. Please take a seat!" Lin Yuanyuan extended her hand generously and shook Zhao An's, inviting him to sit down.

The Lin family is relatively low-key among the four major families, and they conduct business with a down-to-earth approach. They rarely stir up trouble, nor do they often cause disturbances. If a family member occasionally gets involved in a scandal, they are dealt with immediately. If there is any fault, compensation is paid, and punishment is imposed. They are ruthless.

Compared to the other three families, the Lin family is the most low-key and pragmatic. Fighting is relatively rare, and when it does, it's a serious matter, unyielding. They are honest people. But they are also the kind of honest people who are not easy to mess with. Before you think of bullying them, consider your own strength!

"Hello, it's an honor to meet you, Miss Lin. Just call me Zhao An. I'm not some squire, nor do I want to be. I'm just an ordinary country boy. I wonder if you're married?" Zhao An shook hands, flashing his signature smile. He sat on the sofa, putting his cigarette aside.

"No, I'm not married yet." Lin Yuanyuan didn't care; there was nothing to hide. She picked up the boiling kettle and poured it into the teapot filled with tea leaves. She strained the teacup with the first brew, then used a professional pair of tongs to rinse it, letting the rich aroma of the tea linger in the cup while warming it.
Then she brewed more tea and, with a fork, held the cup in front of the two of them, offering a gesture of invitation. "Tea, please."

"Thank you! I'll call you Miss Lin until we're married, and Ms. Lin after we're married." Zhao An took a sip. "Excellent tea, fragrant and sweet. It must be Dahongpao after a rain. Only in the warm and cold regions of the Han River can such tea grow. I'm sure you've been very expensive."

"You're welcome. Just a little tea. It seems you know a lot about tea, Zhao An. This is indeed Dahongpao. I was right, Dahongpao is best after a rain." Lin Yuanyuan didn't rush to talk about the matter, but instead began to chat. It would be much better to start by building rapport and then move on to the topic, and it would be less likely to offend people.
